data.one_liner: Get free and total disk space in megabytes on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: The plugin exposes methods to read the amount of free and total storage on a device. Results are returned in megabytes (MB). It works as a simple Flutter plugin for Android and iOS.
use_when: You need to show available storage to the user
You want to decide whether to download large assets based on free space
You need a quick check before performing cache‑clearing operations
avoid_when: You need support for platforms other than Android or iOS
You need detailed file‑system browsing or management
strengths: Very small and easy to use
Works with the latest Flutter SDK
Returns values in a convenient MB unit
weaknesses: Only Android and iOS are supported
data.setup_notes: Instantiate DiskSpacePlus and await getFreeDiskSpace / getTotalDiskSpace; no extra permissions required

alternatives.name: device_info_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides broader device information, including storage details, in a single package
